criteria.text: Reaction write endpoint keyed by (viewer DID, post URI); emoji in {heart, fire, eyes, joy}; 2xx on success.
Change/remove: new emoji replaces prior; tapping selected emoji removes it. One reaction per viewer per post.
Independent of Like — no cross-triggering in either direction.
Native long-press >=400ms on post body opens bar; release on emoji selects; off-target release dismisses.
issues: Clarify whether 'post body' includes embedded media (images, link cards, quote embeds) or only text/metadata — affects gesture conflict with existing image viewer / link open gestures.

criteria.text: Light-impact haptic on each successful native selection, respecting system prefs.
Web hover >=200ms reveals a React button; click opens popover; outside click / Escape dismisses.
issues: Touch-capable web (iPad, touch laptops) has no true hover — specify fallback (always-visible button, or long-press parity).

criteria.text: Web keyboard: Tab to React button, Enter/Space opens popover with focus on first emoji, arrows move, Enter selects, Escape closes.
Surface scope: PostFeedItem and thread post components only. NOT on quote embeds, search previews, notification items, feed-generator previews.
issues: PostFeedItem verified at src/view/com/posts/PostFeedItem.tsx; exact thread-post component ID should be pinned during arch planning.

criteria.text: Viewer's chosen emoji renders as a chip inline with post controls; persists across restarts and devices for the account.
issues: Cross-device persistence implies server-side storage keyed by DID (confirmed by AC-1 endpoint); local cache alone is insufficient.

criteria.text: No aggregate counts, no other-users reactions, no reacted-by viewer in v0.
A11y: 'React to post' accessibility action opens an accessible picker with localized emoji labels.
Reduced-motion: instant opacity fade only; no scale/translate animation.
All emoji labels pass through Lingui; no hard-coded English.
RTL: emoji order + popover anchor mirror horizontally.
Feature-flag gate 'quick_reactions_v0', default OFF. When OFF: no bar/button/a11y action/network call on any surface. Runtime flip enables without reinstall.
issues: Codebase search shows no established feature-flag primitive in use (only a Statsig logging reference in src/state/session/logging.ts). Arch planning must choose/introduce a gating mechanism.

criteria.text: Optimistic chip update within 100ms; on failure or offline, revert + non-blocking 'Couldn't save reaction' toast, no retry loop.
Rate limit: multiple selections within 2s on the same post debounce to one request for the final selection.
issues: Specify trailing-only debounce vs. leading+trailing. Trailing-only assumed.

criteria.text: Analytics on (a) bar open, (b) emoji select, (c) reaction remove with: post URI hash, emoji code, surface, platform, flag variant.
issues: Specify post URI hash algorithm (e.g., SHA-256 truncated to 16 chars) for privacy-preserving analytics.

questions: AC-4: Does 'post body' include embedded media (images, link cards, quote embeds), or just the text/metadata area? Affects conflict with existing image viewer and link gestures.
AC-6: On touch-capable web (iPad, touch laptops) hover is unreliable — should the React button be always-visible on touch, or should long-press parity apply?
AC-15: Which feature-flag system hosts 'quick_reactions_v0'? Codebase has no established flag primitive today.
AC-17: Is the 2s debounce trailing-only, or leading+trailing?
AC-18: Which hash function/length for the post URI is acceptable for analytics?
AC-9: Cross-device persistence — is this a new Bluesky-owned service (since atproto lexicon is explicitly out of scope), or a scoped reuse of existing infra?
questions_for_reporter: AC-4: Does 'post body' include embedded media (images, link cards, quote embeds), or just the text/metadata area?
AC-6: Touch-web hover fallback — always-visible React button, or long-press parity?
AC-18: Which hash function / length for post URI in analytics?
AC-9: Cross-device persistence backend — given atproto lexicon is out of scope, which service owns reaction storage?
summary: All 18 AC are observable, bounded, and testable. Six soft clarifications captured (gesture target area, touch-web hover fallback, flag infrastructure choice, debounce semantics, URI hash algorithm, cross-device storage backend). No planning blockers.
